sloka: प्रत्यक्षम् यदि अहम् तस्य त्वया स्याम् धर्षिता बलात् ।शयिता त्वम् हतः संख्ये जनस्थाने यथा खरः ॥३-५६-५॥
transliteration: pratyakṣam yadi aham tasya tvayā syām dharṣitā balāt ।śayitā tvam hataḥ saṁkhye janasthāne yathā kharaḥ ॥3-56-5॥

translations.english: Had you abducted me forcibly in his presence, you would have been lying down dead just as Khara in Janasthana.
